### 🔔 NotificationVault — Offline Notification History & Logger

Never lose a deleted or recalled message again! NotificationVault captures incoming notifications in real-time and stores them securely in a local, encrypted SQLite database on your device.

#### ✨ Key Features
- 🔒 **100% Offline & Private:** Zero cloud storage, zero telemetry leakage. Notifications never leave your local device.
- 📱 **Standalone Viewer App (`NotificationVault.app`):** Filter by application bundle (WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messages, Mail) or search message content.
- 🧪 **Live Push Simulation Suite:** Test WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, and Time-Sensitive alerts on demand right from Settings.
- 🌍 **Global 11-Language Localization:** English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, and Vietnamese.
- ⚙️ **Retina 29pt Settings Integration:** Full native settings management with instant database clear and log reporting.
- 🛡️ **100% Free Community Release:** Freeware, strictly non-commercial.
